bottom_line: In patients with acute MI without prior diabetes or chronic heart failure, dapagliflozin vs placebo improved the primary hierarchical composite outcome (win ratio, 1.34; 95% CI, 1.20 to 1.50).
implications: These results support that dapagliflozin, compared with placebo, improved the trial’s primary hierarchical composite outcome (win ratio, 1.34; 95% CI, 1.20 to 1.50). They do not support a difference in cardiovascular death/hospitalization for heart failure based on the reported composite result (50/2019 [2.5%] vs 52/1998 [2.6%]; hazard ratio, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.64 to 1.40).

major_points.text: International registry-based, randomized, double-blind trial in acute MI patients without prior diabetes or chronic heart failure.
major_points.quote: In this international registry-based, randomized, double-blind trial, patients without prior diabetes or chronic heart failure, presenting with acute MI and impaired left ventricular systolic function, were randomly assigned 10 mg of dapagliﬂozin or placebo

major_points.text: Primary endpoint was a hierarchical composite analyzed with a win ratio method.
major_points.quote: The primary outcome was the hierarchical composite of death, hospitalization for heart failure, nonfatal MI, atrial ﬁbrillation/ﬂutter, type 2 diabetes mellitus, New York Heart Association Functional Classiﬁcation at the last visit, and body weight decrease of 5% or greater

major_points.text: No new safety concerns were identified; serious adverse events leading to hospitalization occurred in both groups.
major_points.quote: Serious adverse events leading to hospitalization occurred in 373/1995 (18.7%) patients treated with dapagliﬂozin and in 340/1997 (17.2%) treated with placebo.

absolute_effects.text: Composite of CV death/hospitalization for HF occurred in 50/2019 (2.5%) vs 52/1998 (2.6%).
absolute_effects.quote: The composite of time to cardiovascular death/ hospitalization for HF occurred in 50/2019 (2.5%) pa- tients assigned to dapagliﬂozin and 52/1998 (2.6%) pa- tients assigned to placebo

absolute_effects.text: New diagnosis of type 2 diabetes occurred in 42/2019 (2.1%) vs 78/1998 (3.9%).
absolute_effects.quote: A new diagnosis of type 2 diabetes occurred in 42/2019 (2.1%) patients assigned to dapagliﬂo- zin and 78/1998 (3.9%) patients assigned to placebo

absolute_effects.text: Serious adverse events leading to hospitalization occurred in 373/1995 (18.7%) vs 340/1997 (17.2%).
absolute_effects.quote: Serious adverse events leading to hospitalization occurred in 373/1995 (18.7%) patients treated with dapagliﬂozin and in 340/1997 (17.2%) treated with placebo.

absolute_effects.text: Change in body weight (mean) was -1.41 (-1.75, -1.07) vs 0.24 (-0.11, 0.58).

subgroups.text: Outcomes were consistent across all prespecified subgroups, including LV function and median troponin elevation.
subgroups.quote: outcomes were consistent across all prespe- ciﬁed subgroups, including subgroups based on LV func- tion or median level of troponin elevation

subgroups.text: Subgroup results were presented for country (Sweden vs United Kingdom).
Subgroup results were presented by baseline LVEF categories.

harms.text: Serious adverse events leading to hospitalization occurred in both groups.
harms.quote: Serious adverse events leading to hospitalization occurred in 373/1995 (18.7%) patients treated with dapagliﬂozin and in 340/1997 (17.2%) treated with placebo.

harms.text: Serious adverse events on treatment leading to death occurred in both groups.
harms.quote: Serious adverse events on treatment leading to death occurred in 30/1995 (1.5%) in the dapagliﬂozin group and in 29/1997 (1.5%) in the placebo group.

harms.text: No increase in serious adverse events related to adverse reactions potentially associated with SGLT2 inhibitors.
harms.quote: There was no increase in serious adverse events related to adverse reactions that could potentially be associated with SGLT2 inhibitors, such as ketoacidosis, hypovolemia, hypoten- sion, amputations, or genital infections.

harms.text: Treatment discontinuation for reasons other than death occurred in both groups.
harms.quote: treatment with dapagliﬂozin and placebo was discontinued for reasons other than death in 304/1995 (15.2%) and 256/1977 (12.9%) patients, respectively

guidelines_referenced.quote: was in accordance with recommendations in European Society of Cardiology guidelines23,24

guidelines_referenced.text: 2017 ESC Guidelines for the management of acute myocardial infarction in patients presenting with ST-segment elevation
guidelines_referenced.quote: 2017 ESC Guidelines for the management of acute myocardial infarction in patients presenting with ST-segment elevation

guidelines_referenced.text: 2023 ESC Guidelines for the management of acute coronary syndromes
guidelines_referenced.quote: 2023 ESC Guidelines for the management of acute coronary syndromes.

inclusion_criteria.text: Clinically stable adults (≥18 years of age) hospitalized for acute MI.
inclusion_criteria.quote: Patients eligible for the DAPA-MI trial were clinically sta- ble adults (18 years of age) hospitalized for acute MI

inclusion_criteria.text: Imaging evidence of regional or global impairment of LV systolic function, or definite evidence of Q-wave MI on ECG if imaging not available.
inclusion_criteria.quote: One of the primary inclusion criteria was imaging evidence of regional or global impair- ment of LV systolic function, or if imaging of LV was not available, deﬁnite evidence of Q-wave MI on an electro- cardiogram.

exclusion_criteria.quote: The exclusion criteria included an established diagnosis of diabetes

exclusion_criteria.text: Chronic symptomatic heart failure with hospitalization for HF within the last year associated with reduced LV ejection fraction of 40% or less.
exclusion_criteria.quote: The exclusion criteria included an established diagnosis of diabetes and chronic symptomatic HF with hospitalization for HF within the last year associated with reduced LV ejection fraction of 40% or less.

exclusion_criteria.text: Currently on treatment with an SGLT2 inhibitor.
exclusion_criteria.quote: Patients cur- rently on treatment with an SGLT2 inhibitor, or with an indication for treatment in the opinion of the investigator, were also excluded.

analysis_methods.text: Primary analysis used the win ratio method comparing each treated patient with each control patient.
analysis_methods.quote: analyzed by the win ratio method where each patient in the treatment group was compared with each patient in the control group to determine the win/loss/tie within each pair

analysis_methods.text: Cox proportional-hazards models stratified by country used for secondary time-to-event outcomes.
analysis_methods.quote: Cox proportional-hazards models, including stratiﬁcation by country, were used for all secondary time-to-event out- come analyses.

analysis_methods.text: Primary and secondary efficacy analyses used the intention-to-treat population.
analysis_methods.quote: The intention-to-treat population, consisting of all ran- domly assigned patients irrespective of their protocol ad- herence and continued participation in the trial, was used for the primary and secondary efﬁcacy outcome analyses.

analysis_methods.text: No interim analysis other than total blinded event count for the primary outcome at time of design modification.
analysis_methods.quote: February 2023, with no interim analysis other than a total blinded event count for the primary outcome

trial_conduct.text: Trial and modifications approved by ethical review authorities in Sweden and the UK (with listed reference numbers).
trial_conduct.quote: The trial and its modiﬁcations were approved by the Ethical Review Authority of each country (Swedish Ethical Review Authority Dnr 2020-03087, 2021-03037, 2022- 00101-02, and 2023-01452-02

trial_conduct.text: Written informed consent was provided before randomization.
trial_conduct.quote: All patients who met eligibility criteria and provided writ- ten informed consent were randomly assigned

trial_conduct.text: Independent data monitoring committee assessed safety and reviewed overall conduct.
trial_conduct.quote: An independent data monitoring committee was responsible for assessing the safety of the intervention during the trial and review- ing the overall conduct of the trial.

trial_conduct.text: Independent, blinded clinical end point committee adjudicated hospitalization for HF and death events.
trial_conduct.quote: An independent, blinded clinical end point committee adjudicated all potential hospitalization for HF and death events.

trial_conduct.text: Trial conducted as registry-based, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial at 39 sites in Sweden and 64 in the UK.
trial_conduct.quote: We conducted the DAPA-MI (Dapagliﬂozin in patients with MI) trial as a registry-based, randomized, double- blind, placebo-controlled trial at 39 sites in Sweden and 64 sites in the United Kingdom.

funding_declarations.text: AstraZeneca provided the trial drug (dapagliflozin) and placebo.
funding_declarations.quote: AstraZeneca provided the trial drug (dapagliﬂozin) and placebo.

funding_declarations.text: Executive committee designed the trial and oversaw conduct/analysis in collaboration with the sponsor, AstraZeneca.
funding_declarations.quote: The DAPA-MI executive committee designed the trial and oversaw its conduct and analysis of the data in collabora- tion with the sponsor, AstraZeneca.
Author disclosures and other supplementary materials are available at evidence.nejm.org.

criticisms.text: Trial conducted in two countries with patients predominantly of European descent, potentially affecting generalizability.
criticisms.quote: Trial limitations include that the trial was conducted in two countries with patients predominantly of European descent, which might affect the generalizability to the ﬁndings of other populations

criticisms.text: Observed event rate for CV death and hospitalization for HF was substantially lower than expected, leading to major revision of primary outcome/analysis plan and limited power for clinical outcomes.
criticisms.quote: The observed event rate for cardiovascular death and hospitali- zation for HF were substantially lower than initially ex- pected, resulting in major revision to the primary outcome and analysis plan and limited power

criticisms.text: Acknowledgement that win-ratio outcomes in revised approach could be perceived as favoring dapagliflozin.
criticisms.quote: but we acknowledge that many of the outcomes considered in the win ratio analysis in the revised approach were ones that could be perceived as favoring dapagliﬂozin.
